text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] region-eu serving-health degraded -> 3/5 nodes healthy, p95 latency > 1.2s (alert triggered)
Sam: seeing the page, I'm on it. pinging infra.
Anya: I can take first contact with customers (standup-signal). Is there a known degradation or rolling deploy?
Ryan: not that I'm aware of. No deploy events in the last hour in eu clusters.
Sam: attaching quick metrics snapshot: `curl https://dashboards.redwood/region-eu/health?snapshot=now` -> lots of 5xx from shard-a.
ops-bot: deploy-bot reported: no active deploys in region-eu in the past 90m.
Sam: starting mitigation checklist: 1) confirm if it's a routing/edge vs backend 2) throttle non-critical background traffic 3) failover traffic if necessary
Maria: adding to handoff — I'll standby for customer comms. any customer-facing impact yet?
Sam: small — a few customer sessions reported slow completions; internal logs show spike in `kv-cache-miss` on shard-a.
Anya: can we temporarily flip routing policy to prefer region-us for new sessions? need to avoid session loss.
Ryan: we can, but need to update LB rules. doing a canary shift of 10% now.
Sam: please `kubectl scale` the read-replica pool on shard-b by +2 while we test.
Ryan: done: `kubectl scale deploy/replica-pool -n eu --replicas=8` -> pods coming up.
incident-bot: [NOTE] pager cleared for Sam (acknowledged at 1831200600)
Anya: I noticed a flood of low-severity alerts from the `prefix-cache-latency` monitor — noisy during this incident. thinking we should silence/adjust thresholds after mitigation.
Sam: agreed. current plan: stabilize traffic, confirm failover capacity, then post-incident tweak alerts and add a dedicated regional failover dashboard tile.
Maria: customers impacted: acct-472 and partner-ingest pipelines experienced elevated latency; ops reached out to acct-472 via email, awaiting acknowledgement.
Ryan: traffic shift update: canary to us hit ~12% of new sessions, error rate on eu dropped from 6.1% -> 2.0% in 5m. CPU on eu control-plane still high (85%).
Sam: good. start background job throttles on non-interactive tenants in eu: `POST /admin/throttle?scope=background&region=eu`
ops-bot: background throttle API responded 200.
Anya: while we do this, I'm drafting a short status note for the status page: "Degraded performance in EU region caused increased errors; automated traffic routing in effect; engineering investigating."
Sam: once stable, we need a post-incident action list:
- tune `prefix-cache-latency` alert to ignore transient spikes under 90s window
- create a regional failover dashboard with real-time traffic split, p95/p99, node health, and `kv-cache-miss` rates
- add an automated runbook step to shift 20% traffic to next healthy region on p95>1s for >3m
- add a synthetic probe hitting critical endpoints from outside the eu region to detect routing-induced regressions
Anya: adding: include a muted-exception list so internal warmup jobs don't trigger failovers.
Maria: customer comms: sent update to acct-472 and partner team. Asked for logs and impact window.
Sam: we should also audit the alert thresholds that fired: `region-eu-serving-health` uses node-count < 70% as critical; maybe change to 60% because of planned maintenance noise. but we must be conservative.
Ryan: propose: change alert to trigger only if node-count<70% AND p95>1s for 5m. reduces noise. I'll open a PR for alerting config after this.
incident-bot: [RESOLUTION] region-eu serving-health returned to 5/5 nodes, p95 back to 420ms (resolved at 1831203600)
Sam: confirmed recovery. removing canary routing, normal flow by 1831203700.
Anya: filing postmortem stub and tagging oncall rotation. We should schedule a quick retro with SRE and infra tomorrow.
Maria: I'll post the customer impact summary in #support and follow up with any escalations.
Sam: final immediate followups (I'll own first two): 1) alert tuning PR (Ryan) 2) dashboard tile + synthetic probe (Anya) 3) runbook update to include 20% shift (Sam) 4) customer sync notes (Maria)
Ryan: opening PR: https://git.redwood/alerts/PR-554 
Anya: dashboard ticket -> https://jira.redwood/browse/OPS-1342
Maria: thanks team. great coordination — we'll do a brief blameless retro. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident closed in PagerDuty at 1831203820
